**Current behavior**
<!-- Describe how the bug manifests. -->

AoT builds with "noUnusedLocals": true lead to error messages like this:

`
Error at .../aot/app/shared/gauge/gauge.component.ngfactory.ts:41:7: 'RenderType_GaugeComponent_Host' is declared but never used.

Error at .../aot/app/shared/timer-editor.component.ngfactory.ts:76:11: 'comp' is declared but never used.

Error at .../aot/app/shared/timer-editor.component.ngfactory.ts:1548:9: 'comp' is declared but never used.

Error at .../aot/app/shared/timer-editor.component.ngfactory.ts:1632:7: 'RenderType_TimerEditorComponent_Host' is declared but never used.
`

**Expected behavior**
<!-- Describe what the behavior would be without the bug. -->

AoT compiler should be either compatible with noUnusedLocals out of the box, or there should be some way to disable this checks in generated sources.

**Minimal reproduction of the problem with instructions**
<!--
If the current behavior is a bug or you can illustrate your feature request better with an example, 
please provide the *STEPS TO REPRODUCE* and if possible a *MINIMAL DEMO* of the problem via
https://plnkr.co or similar (you can use this template as a starting point: http://plnkr.co/edit/tpl:AvJOMERrnz94ekVua0u5).
-->

I can provide some reproduction testcase, but it seems that there is nothing special - it just happens with all components here.
